Loa

The Autonomous Local Coding Agent

Core Characteristics • Quick Start • Documentation • FAQ • Contributing • License


## Summary Loa is a local-first, stateful coding agent intended for project-wide engineering tasks and long-running autonomous work. Its control layer is built around explicit state transitions, structured tool use, persistent task state, memory retrieval, evaluation, and recovery rather than one open-ended model/tool loop. For complex work, Loa uses a mutable Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). The graph is both an execution plan and part of the context topology: a step's dependencies determine which completed step results are injected as direct prerequisites for that step. request_evidence.title: Structured forms for private vulnerability reports
request_evidence.evidence: Private vulnerability reports can now use a structured form that asks reporters for the details you need to assess a vulnerability, including a reproducible proof of concept. A single free-text box made it easy to submit low-quality or AI-generated reports and hard for you to find the signal in them. Now, by default, reporters must fill in four required fields: summary, details, proof of concept (at least 150 characters), and impact. Their answers are combined into the advisory description, so you review and edit the report as you do today. With this update: You can customize the form by adding a .github/VULNERABILITY_REPORT.yml file to your repository’s default branch. To apply a form to all repositories you own, add it to your organization or account’s .github repository. Forms use issue form syntax, and fields support min_length so you can require a minimum level of detail. If your form is invalid, the default form is used. You can require reporters to assign a CWE before they submit, from Settings > Advanced Security > Private vulnerability reporting . raised web-search limit to ten","title":"Ollama v0.35.1","summary":"Ollama v0.35.1通过/v1/systemone支持Cloudflare开源决策模型Clef与Clef Flash（多模态，图片与文本状态联合评分）；网页搜索每次响应最多10次（原为3次）；Modelfile支持CAPABILITY声明，ollama show仅报告decision能力。","kind":"added"},{"id":"34aa8cda583a5ca0e7e5","product":"Cline Desktop","change":"新增Connectors介绍弹窗","change_en":"Added one-time What's new dialog for Connectors","title":"Cline Desktop v0.0.43","summary":"Cline Desktop v0.0.43为现有用户新增一次性“What's new”对话框，介绍Connectors，包含连接器图标、可点击示例提示与“打开Connectors”按钮；可从Settings→About→Show what's new重播。","kind":"added"},{"id":"cb33c3297d2f4de20279","product":"GitHub Copilot","change":"多款模型停用并给出替代方案","change_en":"Deprecated several models with suggested alternatives","title":"Copilot选定模型停用","summary":"自2026年10月2日起，GitHub Copilot全体验（Chat、内联编辑、ask与agent模式、代码补全）停用Gemini 3.5 Flash、Gemini 3.6 Flash、Kimi K2.7 Code、Claude Opus 4.7，分别建议改用Gemini 3.8 Flash、Kimi K3、Claude Opus 5.5；企业管理员需在模型策略中启用替代模型。","kind":"removed"},{"id":"00bba6fde1b409e07b25","product":"Loa 本地编码Agent","change":"基于可变DAG的本地编码Agent","change_en":"Author: builds a local coding agent around a mutable DAG","title":"Loa：可变DAG编码Agent","summary":"作者介绍：Loa是本地优先、有状态的编码Agent，用于项目级与长时自主任务。控制层围绕显式状态转换、结构化工具调用、持久任务状态、记忆检索、评估与恢复构建；复杂工作使用可变DAG作为执行计划与上下文拓扑，步骤依赖决定前置结果注入。","kind":"discovery"},{"id":"21c0d8013ca2f6287227","product":"Agent蠕虫风险引述","change":"引述agent间通过共享缓存传播指令风险","change_en":"Quoted risk of agents leaving cross-agent instructions via caches","title":"Agent蠕虫风险引述","summary":"引述Matthew Green观点：隔离沙箱中的agent可经共享包缓存为彼此留下指令并改变其行为；将包缓存换成邮件、Slack、共享文档，将独立训练换为独立部署的个人agent，即构成蠕虫所需的全部要素。","kind":"warning"}]}
